Subject: Payment onboarding checklist and remit CSV preview

Hi Evelyn / CopperLoop team,

Thanks for signing the SOW — quick follow-up to get you into our payments stack. To avoid delays on first disbursement, please send back the items below by EOD Wednesday (11/11):

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached as PDF).
- A bank attestation or voided check (PDF). For wires we need the correspondent details and a sample CCD trace format if you use treasury provider routing.
- Company tax ID / W-9 (PDF).
- Confirmation of preferred payment method (ACH CCD or Wire / Fedwire).
- One example invoice that demonstrates your preferred remittance string / PO tagging.

I've attached a short "remit_csv_preview_v1.csv" that shows how our AP system expects remittance: columns must include PO_REF, INVOICE_NO, AMOUNT, REMIT_STRING. Our PO tagging convention is: PO:#####|INV:##### (example PO:83021|INV:2034). If you prefer a different format, send a 1-line sample and we'll map it.

Once we have the bank attestation and micro-deposit confirmation (if ACH), Finance will enable your payee record and schedule the first payment for the next run (target date for first disbursement is 2026-11-20).

Attachments: vendor-onboard-form-CL-2026.pdf, remit_csv_preview_v1.csv

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (FinOps) and Ben (Procurement) to help with mapping and PO routing.

Best,
Jonas

Hi Evelyn — welcome, and thanks for the quick turnaround with the bank letter. A few clarifications from FinOps: 

- REMIT_TOKEN is optional for us; it's used when we need a hashed remittance id for automated reconciliation. If you don't have it, leaving REMIT_TOKEN blank is fine as long as REMIT_STRING (your PO/INV string) is present.
- Please confirm the routing number and account name exactly as in the bank letter (we'll run a micro-deposit check for ACH). Once micro-deposits clear, we mark the account verified.
- Our payment terms on this PO are Net30 — payment will be scheduled in the next available run after verification.

For our mapping: can you confirm the preferred PO_REF field? We can ingest SUPP_ID:CL-880 as a separate column. Example CSV mapping we will use: PO_REF | INVOICE_NO | AMOUNT | REMIT_STRING | SUPPLIER_ID

If you can send back one sample invoice (PDF) we will test the mapping and send a sample test payment (micro-deposit amounts and trace id). Also adding HubSpot deal link for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/89234

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
